versions.objective:
Build "Squeek Pet": a browser virtual-pet game where your own pixel hamster lives in sync with Squeektoshi, the real hamster whose wheel powers Squeekchain (a proof-of-work toychain on Ethereum Sepolia). Static site, no backend, no wallet, mobile-first, saves in localStorage.

CORE IDEA
Your pet mirrors the real wheel. When Squeektoshi runs, your pet can run beside him and earn Seeds. When he sleeps, your pet naps and recovers faster. Real wheel milestones become in-game events. Care for the pet with Seeds. The pet never dies; neglect only makes it grumpy and slow.

DATA (public, read-only, CORS open, no key)
Base: https://api.squeekchain.com/v1. Big numbers are decimal strings: parse with BigInt or Number carefully. If a response has "status":"unavailable", treat values as unknown, never as zero.
- GET /status (poll every 15 s while the tab is visible): measurement.coreStatus ("ACTIVE" running, "IDLE" resting, "COUNTER_FAULT"), measurement.freshness ("online"/"stale"), measurement.rpmMilli (rpm x1000), measurement.speedMmPerSecond, measurement.distanceMm (distance in the current Squeek day), measurement.cumulativeWorkUnits (total magnet passes; 1 pass = 1 work unit), builder.anchor.blockHeight (Squeek blocks), builder.anchor.blockProgress (0..1e9 = progress to next block).
- GET /measurement/stats?range=7d (poll every 5 min): activity.days[] each {date, observedWorkUnits, distanceMm, buckets[48] {startMinuteUtc, workUnits}}; a Squeek day runs 12:00 to 12:00 UTC and is named by its starting noon, so buckets with startMinuteUtc >= 720 are on "date", others on the next calendar day. Also records{} (peakObservedSpeedMmPerSecond, maximumDailyDistanceMm, ...).
- GET /events?category=measurement&limit=20 (poll every 2 min): events[] {id, type, occurredAt, payload}; types include measurement.speed_record, measurement.distance_milestone, measurement.daily_distance_milestone, measurement.speed_milestone, measurement.distance_streak.
Handle 429 (wait Retry-After), timeouts and offline with a calm "Can't reach the wheel right now" state; the game stays playable from saved state. Never call the API more often than listed.

GAME RULES
Stats 0-100: Hunger (rises), Happiness, Energy, Cleanliness (fall). Decay continues while the page is closed, computed from saved timestamps, capped at 12 hours of decay.
- Sync run: when coreStatus is ACTIVE and pet Energy >= 20, the pet runs on its wheel. Each new real magnet pass (difference in cumulativeWorkUnits between polls) gives 1 Seed, max 600 Seeds per real hour. Running costs Energy and adds Hunger.
- Away earnings: on return, sum workUnits from the 7-day buckets that fall inside the time away (max 12 h) and credit 50% as Seeds, shown as a "While you were away, Squeektoshi ran X passes; your pet earned Y Seeds" card.
- Nap together: when the real wheel is IDLE, Energy recovers 2x faster.
- Care actions: Feed (sunflower seed, carrot, mealworm: different costs and effects), Play (toy), Clean, Pet (free, small Happiness, 10/day cap).
- Growth: XP from care and sync runs. Stages: Pup, Junior, Adult, Wheel Legend.
- Shop for Seeds: foods, toys (tunnel, chew stick, ball), cosmetics (3 hats, 3 wheel skins, cage backgrounds). Cosmetics are visible on the pet.
- Daily quests (3 per Squeek day, reset at 12:00 UTC), some tied to real data, e.g. "Squeektoshi runs 2 km this Squeek day" (status distanceMm), "Be here when a new Squeek block lands" (blockHeight increases while open), "Pet your hamster 5 times". Show progress bars.
- Festivals: a new measurement.speed_record or distance milestone event (newer than last seen, dedupe by id) starts a 1-hour 2x Seeds festival with a banner.
- Never encourage or pressure the real hamster to run. Copy is kind: naps are good too.

SCREENS
1. Home: cage scene with the pet (idle, eat, run, sleep, happy, grumpy animations), stat bars, Seeds balance, buttons for actions. A "Squeektoshi live" strip: running/resting pill, rpm, km/h, km today, progress to next Squeek block, and a link to the official stream page https://sepolia.squeekchain.com.
2. Shop. 3. Quests. 4. Wardrobe (equip cosmetics). 5. About: how the sync works, data source, "unofficial fan game, testnet values have no monetary value".
First visit: adopt flow (name the pet, pick fur color from 4).

ART AND FEEL
Original pixel art drawn in code on canvas (no copyrighted assets, no external images). Warm, cute, readable. Light and dark themes via prefers-color-scheme. Large tap targets, works at 360 px wide, keyboard accessible, prefers-reduced-motion respected. Optional Web Audio blips with a mute toggle, off by default.

TECH
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript or a small Vite build; output a static export that works from IPFS under any path (relative asset URLs, hash routing, no server). No trackers, no analytics, no wallet connection. Save: one versioned localStorage key, with export/import of the save as a text code. Keep game logic in pure functions (decay, earnings, quest progress) with unit tests, and document the API mapping in README.md.

ACCEPTANCE
- Loads with live data from api.squeekchain.com; shows correct running/resting state and numbers.
- With the API blocked, the game still loads and is playable.
- Sync run only earns while coreStatus is ACTIVE; earnings respect the hourly cap.
- Closing the page for 2 hours then returning applies capped decay and the away-earnings card.
- Quests reset at 12:00 UTC; festival starts once per new milestone event.
- No horizontal scroll at 360 px; no console errors.
- README explains setup, the rules above and the data fields used.

Squeek Pet v2: polish the existing game in this repository. Keep the stack (Vite + TypeScript), the file layout, the save key squeek-pet:v1 and every existing rule unless a change below says otherwise. Old saves must keep loading: add new save fields as optional with defaults in parseSave. Rebuild and commit dist/ as before.

1. BUG: festival on first visit
Seen on the live site: a new player adopted a hamster at 08:05 UTC and a 2x festival started immediately, although the newest qualifying event (measurement.distance_milestone, occurredAt 04:04:30Z) was 4 hours old. processEvents is meant to count only events from the last hour on the first fetch. Find the path that lets an old event through (adopt flow calls applyEvents(lastEvents, Date.now()) in src/main.ts; check processEvents in src/logic.ts, the save passed in, and any event fetched before adoption). Fix it and add a unit test reproducing exactly this case: fresh save, events all older than 1 hour, no festival. Also: a newly adopted pet must never get a festival from an event that happened before its bornAt.

2. Squeektoshi's records card (data already parsed)
On Home, under the live strip, add a compact "Squeektoshi's records" card from /measurement/stats?range=7d records: top speed (km/h, from peakObservedSpeedMmPerSecond x 0.0036), longest Squeek day (km, maximumDailyDistanceMm / 1e6), peak rpm (peakObservedRpmMilli / 1000), most passes in 30 minutes (mostWorkHalfHour), with the date of each. Unknown values show "n/a". Also show "Last ran: X ago" in the live strip when the wheel is IDLE, computed from the latest 30-minute bucket with workUnits > 0 (reuse bucketStart).

3. Share card
Add a "Share my hamster" button on Home that draws a 1200x630 PNG on a canvas: the pet in its current pose with equipped hat, wheel skin and background, its name, stage, Seeds earned in total (add a lifetime seedsEarned counter to the save), days together (from bornAt), the line "Runs in sync with Squeektoshi on Squeekchain" and the site address. Offer "Download image" (blob URL + a download link) and, where navigator.share with files is supported, "Share". No upload anywhere.

4. Vietnamese language
Add an EN / VI switch in the header, saved in the save (default: browser language, vi* -> VI). Move every user-facing string, including toasts, quest titles, item names and notes, the About text and the away card, into one dictionary (src/i18n.ts) with English and Vietnamese. Vietnamese must be natural, not word-for-word. Numbers and dates use Intl with the chosen locale. Keep the html lang attribute in sync.

5. Recent milestones on Home
Below the records card, list the 3 newest events from /events?category=measurement already fetched (speed records, distance milestones, daily distance milestones, distance streaks) as short lines with relative time, e.g. "Passed 40 km in total, 4 h ago", "New top speed 5.9 km/h". Use the payload fields thresholdDistanceMm, recordMmPerSecond, days, minimumDailyDistanceMm. Ignore unknown types.

6. Credits and links (About screen)
Add a "Made by" line: "Made by @Truongsonxyz" linking to https://x.com/Truongsonxyz, and a "Join Squeekchain Genesis" link to https://squeekchain.com/genesis/e86n3z8y with one sentence: "Genesis is Squeekchain's community campaign before launch." Plus a link to the source repository. Plain links, no tracking parameters.

7. Small fixes
- Feed menu: show how many of each food are in the pantry and grey out foods you can't afford, with the price in words for screen readers.
- When the hourly Seed cap is reached, show the reset time ("more Seeds at 15:42") instead of only the toast.
- The away card must also appear when the 7-day log arrives later than the status call (check settleAway is reached in both orders) and must never be shown twice for the same away window.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the confetti and the running animation (slow walk instead of spin).

DO NOT
Do not add a wallet, a backend, analytics, trackers, external fonts or images. Do not raise API poll rates (status 15 s, stats 5 min, events 2 min, only while visible). Do not change the economy numbers.

ACCEPTANCE
- npm run build and npm test pass; new unit tests cover: the festival first-visit case, a pet never getting a festival from events before bornAt, the last-ran calculation, seedsEarned accumulating from runs, away earnings and quests, and save migration (a v1 save without the new fields loads with defaults).
- Switching EN/VI changes every visible string on all screens with no leftovers, and persists after reload.
- Share card downloads a 1200x630 PNG that shows the equipped cosmetics.
- Records and milestones show live values from api.squeekchain.com, and "n/a" when blocked.
- No horizontal scroll at 320 px and 390 px; no console errors; dist/ rebuilt and committed; README updated (new features, i18n file, share card, save fields).

jobs.objective:
_Squeek Companion — dynamic ERC-721 on Sepolia (Squeekchain)
MD Job Brief (Job 1/2 — Contract) — "Squeek Companion": dynamic ERC-721 on Sepolia
Goal
Build, test and deploy on Sepolia (chain ID 11155111) a dynamic ERC-721 collection
"Squeek Companion" whose artwork and traits change automatically with Squeektoshi's real
activity, derived fully on-chain from SqueekCore. No oracle, no keeper, no upkeep transactions.
(This is job 1 of 2. Job 2 will build the mint/gallery website on top of the deployed
contract address from this job.)
Background
Squeekchain is a hamster-powered proof-of-work "toychain" on Ethereum Sepolia. SqueekCore
settles the hamster's wheel work in 10-minute rounds.
Docs: https://docs.squeekchain.com (SqueekCore page documents every function; published ABI
JSON under Developers > Deployments).
SqueekCore proxy on Sepolia: 0x74665dAecA35A2303e767E76a2FF1FB6F93e119f
(Transparent proxy, implementation v3 — always call through the proxy address.)
Key reads (permissionless view functions):
state() -> CoreState { settledThroughRound, cumulativeBlockUnits, ... }
  Squeek block height = cumulativeBlockUnits / 1_000_000_000
roundPage(afterRound, throughRound, maxRecords) -> active rounds only, 0-16 records.
  Reverts with InvalidRoundPageBounds on reversed ranges or ends past the frontier —
  clamp inputs (if frontier < 12, start at round 0).
Contract requirements
ERC-721, name "Squeek Companion" (placeholder), symbol e.g. SQUEEKCOMP, fixed supply 999.
Free public mint on Sepolia, max 1 per wallet (900 tokens for the public).
99 tokens reserved for the owner address
  0x3C7838665Ff8215c95500E1a6306e19E146674a0
  (mint to the owner at deploy, or via an owner-only reserve function; the public mint
  must never be able to touch the reserve).
On-chain hamster-state derivation in the contract:
Read state() for settledThroughRound and block height.
Read roundPage(frontier-12, frontier, 16) (12 rounds ~= 2 hours).
Rules: active round with work > 0 in last 3 rounds -> RUNNING;
    else active round with work > 0 in last 12 rounds -> NAPPING; else SLEEPING.
Fully on-chain SVG inside tokenURI (data-URI JSON), re-rendered live on every read:
Pixel-art hamster: eyes open + motion lines + warm background when RUNNING;
    eyes closed + "Zzz" + night background when NAPPING;
    deeper night + moon when SLEEPING.
Overlay text: current Squeek block height (dynamic).
Metadata attributes: state (RUNNING/NAPPING/SLEEPING, dynamic),
  squeek_block (dynamic), mint_block (static).
Immutable contract (no proxy, no upgradeability). No other owner backdoors.
Foundry test suite: state-derivation logic against a mocked SqueekCore covering
  RUNNING / NAPPING / SLEEPING / frontier-edge cases; mint limits; reserve protection.
Non-goals
No mainnet deployment. No token sale, no real money.
Nothing that encourages or forces the hamster's behavior — the NFT only reflects
  observed on-chain state.
No website in this job (job 2).
Acceptance criteria
Deployed on Sepolia; source verified (or ABI published); deployment tx linked.
mint() works from a fresh wallet; 1-per-wallet limit enforced; 999 cap enforced.
99 reserve tokens held by the owner address; public mint cannot mint them.
tokenURI returns valid data-URI JSON; SVG visibly differs across the three states
      (demonstrate by simulating each state).
README with contract address, how state derivation works, and how to verify it.

Token symbol: SQCOM
Token name: _Squeek Companion

STRATOKS — CORRECTNESS, RICHER AGENCY AND A LIVING SOCIETY

Continue STRATOKS: an original evolving society inspired by Plaything/Thronglets. Deliver measurable mechanisms, not claims of consciousness or human intelligence. Preserve the whole 280x280 world: forests, desert/oases, cold highlands, coasts/islands, exploration and migration. No production access/deployment, paid inference, tokens or payments.

FIX ALL EIGHT OPEN DEFECTS FIRST
1. Tile-evidence HUD overlaps/close-button failure on small/landscape phones: safe-area-aware panel, reachable close/Escape/focus return.
2. Camera clamping prevents exploration/picking at world corners: correct isometric bounds/viewports without hiding valid edge tiles; test all four corners, zoom/aspect ratios and negative chunks.
3. Terrain remains flat: actual connected cliff faces, rocky bank relief and readable heights using authoritative terrain/adjacency. Share projection and picking; no invented passable crossings.
4. Repair pose expects phase "work" but engine emits "repair": map actual emitted activity; retain tool/material gates.
5. Settlements navigator title wrongly says "Resident inspector": correct heading.
6. Exact store contents leak from distant sight: only actual visit/interaction updates stock knowledge. Distant sight reveals appearance, not stock; memory stays stale until revisited. Prevent indirect planner/state-query leaks.
7. Ruins at integrity 0 function as stores/finished homes: disable normal use/protection, preserve contents, expose ruins truthfully; recovery requires repair or explicit nearby salvage.
8. Newly chosen build step reports idle: consistent starting/working/progress states.
Reproduce defects; deliver tests and a resolution table. An accepted review is not a resolved finding.

MORE THAN FISHING
Extend existing learned planner and mb-v1 rather than replacing them. Add persistent bounded goals and subgoals (needs, curiosity, safety, social ties); interruption by danger/changed conditions, resumption and alternative strategies. Do not assign permanent scripted professions or a global colony director.
Use extensible object/material capabilities and action preconditions/effects/costs. Residents combine primitives such as inspect, move, collect, carry, place, combine, use, tend, repair, share and signal. New objects participate through properties, not bespoke brains. Physical rules/recipes are designed; experience-derived preferences/predictions must remain learned. Capabilities do not reveal recipes.
Implement and test at least three additional functional chains: plant/tend/harvest with climate/water constraints; prepare/cook existing food using fuel/heat with conservation; voluntarily help provision/repair another resident's shelter based on local needs/relationships. These demonstrate reusable actions; do not force their sequence. Retain fishing, exploration, tool wear, construction, rest, reproduction, ageing and death.

LOCAL COMMUNICATION AND INDIVIDUALITY
Add bounded local signal production/perception with neutral glyphs or tones. Signal associations and receiver responses arise from repeated local co-occurrence and observed outcomes; no globally pretranslated "food/danger" dictionary or scripted English dialogue. Respect distance, attention, uncertainty and false/misunderstood signals. Keep individual experience, personality and trust. No shared omniscient memory. Show signal/response history and confidence, not invented thoughts. Label this limited learned signaling.

WORLD PRESENTATION
Keep golden leaf-crowned Stratoks; no rabbit ears, muzzles or tails. Improve character/building scale, depth ordering, terrain transitions and environmental layers across EVERY biome. State-driven farming/cooking/helping/repair animations; no fake activity props. Preserve mobile controls, follow/search/minimap and scientific inspector. Show goals, observations, predictions, outcomes and communication evidence. Hide unavailable features.

VALIDATION AND DELIVERY
Preserve live world identity, residents, weights, memories, relationships and terrain; migrate copies with versioned defaults, exact original backup, restart/rollback tests. No resets/culling. Bounded CPU/memory on the small ARM VPS; benchmark honestly.
Use multiple fixed seeds plus changed/depleted resources. Compare learning enabled/frozen and communication enabled/disabled; report failures, causal effects and action/strategy diversity, not just attractive videos. Verify material conservation and no social-signal/reward loops. Reproduce evidence with deterministic replay.
Deliver source/patch, reproducible build, working isolated updated-engine demo, static IMD review preview, screenshots/recordings across biomes and phones, raw tests/timings and owner deployment instructions. Separate review from structural acceptance. Unresolved high defects or missing mechanisms must be explicitly listed, never advertised as complete.

Residents combine primitives such as inspect, move, collect, carry, place, combine, use, tend, repair, share and signal. New objects participate through properties, not bespoke brains. Use multiple fixed seeds plus changed/depleted resources. Compare learning enabled/frozen and communication enabled/disabled; report failures, causal effects and action/strategy diversity, not just attractive videos. Verify material conservation and no social-signal/reward loops. Reproduce evidence with deterministic replay.

versions.objective:
Build "Squeek Pet": a browser virtual-pet game where your own pixel hamster lives in sync with Squeektoshi, the real hamster whose wheel powers Squeekchain (a proof-of-work toychain on Ethereum Sepolia). Static site, no backend, no wallet, mobile-first, saves in localStorage.

CORE IDEA
Your pet mirrors the real wheel. When Squeektoshi runs, your pet can run beside him and earn Seeds. When he sleeps, your pet naps and recovers faster. Real wheel milestones become in-game events. Care for the pet with Seeds. The pet never dies; neglect only makes it grumpy and slow.

DATA (public, read-only, CORS open, no key)
Base: https://api.squeekchain.com/v1. Big numbers are decimal strings: parse with BigInt or Number carefully. If a response has "status":"unavailable", treat values as unknown, never as zero.
- GET /status (poll every 15 s while the tab is visible): measurement.coreStatus ("ACTIVE" running, "IDLE" resting, "COUNTER_FAULT"), measurement.freshness ("online"/"stale"), measurement.rpmMilli (rpm x1000), measurement.speedMmPerSecond, measurement.distanceMm (distance in the current Squeek day), measurement.cumulativeWorkUnits (total magnet passes; 1 pass = 1 work unit), builder.anchor.blockHeight (Squeek blocks), builder.anchor.blockProgress (0..1e9 = progress to next block).
- GET /measurement/stats?range=7d (poll every 5 min): activity.days[] each {date, observedWorkUnits, distanceMm, buckets[48] {startMinuteUtc, workUnits}}; a Squeek day runs 12:00 to 12:00 UTC and is named by its starting noon, so buckets with startMinuteUtc >= 720 are on "date", others on the next calendar day. Also records{} (peakObservedSpeedMmPerSecond, maximumDailyDistanceMm, ...).
- GET /events?category=measurement&limit=20 (poll every 2 min): events[] {id, type, occurredAt, payload}; types include measurement.speed_record, measurement.distance_milestone, measurement.daily_distance_milestone, measurement.speed_milestone, measurement.distance_streak.
Handle 429 (wait Retry-After), timeouts and offline with a calm "Can't reach the wheel right now" state; the game stays playable from saved state. Never call the API more often than listed.

GAME RULES
Stats 0-100: Hunger (rises), Happiness, Energy, Cleanliness (fall). Decay continues while the page is closed, computed from saved timestamps, capped at 12 hours of decay.
- Sync run: when coreStatus is ACTIVE and pet Energy >= 20, the pet runs on its wheel. Each new real magnet pass (difference in cumulativeWorkUnits between polls) gives 1 Seed, max 600 Seeds per real hour. Running costs Energy and adds Hunger.
- Away earnings: on return, sum workUnits from the 7-day buckets that fall inside the time away (max 12 h) and credit 50% as Seeds, shown as a "While you were away, Squeektoshi ran X passes; your pet earned Y Seeds" card.
- Nap together: when the real wheel is IDLE, Energy recovers 2x faster.
- Care actions: Feed (sunflower seed, carrot, mealworm: different costs and effects), Play (toy), Clean, Pet (free, small Happiness, 10/day cap).
- Growth: XP from care and sync runs. Stages: Pup, Junior, Adult, Wheel Legend.
- Shop for Seeds: foods, toys (tunnel, chew stick, ball), cosmetics (3 hats, 3 wheel skins, cage backgrounds). Cosmetics are visible on the pet.
- Daily quests (3 per Squeek day, reset at 12:00 UTC), some tied to real data, e.g. "Squeektoshi runs 2 km this Squeek day" (status distanceMm), "Be here when a new Squeek block lands" (blockHeight increases while open), "Pet your hamster 5 times". Show progress bars.
- Festivals: a new measurement.speed_record or distance milestone event (newer than last seen, dedupe by id) starts a 1-hour 2x Seeds festival with a banner.
- Never encourage or pressure the real hamster to run. Copy is kind: naps are good too.

SCREENS
1. Home: cage scene with the pet (idle, eat, run, sleep, happy, grumpy animations), stat bars, Seeds balance, buttons for actions. A "Squeektoshi live" strip: running/resting pill, rpm, km/h, km today, progress to next Squeek block, and a link to the official stream page https://sepolia.squeekchain.com.
2. Shop. 3. Quests. 4. Wardrobe (equip cosmetics). 5. About: how the sync works, data source, "unofficial fan game, testnet values have no monetary value".
First visit: adopt flow (name the pet, pick fur color from 4).

Original pixel art drawn in code on canvas (no copyrighted assets, no external images). Warm, cute, readable. Light and dark themes via prefers-color-scheme. Large tap targets, works at 360 px wide, keyboard accessible, prefers-reduced-motion respected. Optional Web Audio blips with a mute toggle, off by default.

TECH
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript or a small Vite build; output a static export that works from IPFS under any path (relative asset URLs, hash routing, no server). No trackers, no analytics, no wallet connection. Save: one versioned localStorage key, with export/import of the save as a text code. Keep game logic in pure functions (decay, earnings, quest progress) with unit tests, and document the API mapping in README.md.

ACCEPTANCE
- Loads with live data from api.squeekchain.com; shows correct running/resting state and numbers.
- With the API blocked, the game still loads and is playable.
- Sync run only earns while coreStatus is ACTIVE; earnings respect the hourly cap.
- Closing the page for 2 hours then returning applies capped decay and the away-earnings card.
- Quests reset at 12:00 UTC; festival starts once per new milestone event.
- No horizontal scroll at 360 px; no console errors.
- README explains setup, the rules above and the data fields used.

jobs.objective:
Build "Squeek Odometer", a single-page stream companion and transaction tool for Squeekchain (Ethereum Sepolia, chainId 11155111). Static site, no backend, plain HTML/CSS/JS, works on desktop and phone.

DATA (public, CORS open, fetch from the browser every 15 seconds)
- GET https://api.squeekchain.com/v1/status
  measurement.coreStatus (SPINNING / IDLE), measurement.rpmMilli, measurement.speedMmPerSecond, measurement.distanceMm (tonight), measurement.cumulativeWorkUnits, measurement.freshness, builder.anchor.blockHeight, builder.anchor.blockProgress (0..1e9)
- GET https://api.squeekchain.com/v1/economy/state  -> supply.totalMintedBaseUnits (divide by 1e18 = SQK), identities.token (SQK token address)
- GET https://api.squeekchain.com/v1/settlements?range=24h  -> buckets[] with workAdded, settlementCount, completedBlockCount
- GET https://api.squeekchain.com/v1/measurement/stats?range=30d  -> nightly distance history
If the API fails, keep the last good values and show "last updated X min ago" instead of blanking.

1. LIVE ODOMETER (main view)
- Big animated hamster wheel that spins at the real RPM and stops when coreStatus is IDLE.
- Status line: "SQUEEKTOSHI IS RUNNING" / "RESTING" / "WHEEL OFFLINE".
- Tonight's distance as a rolling odometer (km with 3 decimals), current speed in km/h, RPM.
- Fun conversions of tonight's and all-time distance: % of a marathon, laps of a 400 m track, times around a football pitch.
- Squeekchain block height with a progress bar, SQK minted so far.
- 30-night bar chart of distance per night, highlight the record night.

2. STREAM OVERLAY MODE (for the hamster livestream / OBS)
- Open with ?overlay=1: transparent background, no page chrome, only a compact card (wheel icon, RUNNING/RESTING, tonight's km, speed).
- ?overlay=1&size=small|large and ?theme=light|dark.
- A "Copy OBS overlay link" button on the main page that copies the overlay URL.

3. SEND A TRANSACTION (wallet tool)
- "Connect wallet" button using EIP-6963 so it works when several wallets are installed (MetaMask, Rabby, etc.); let the user pick the wallet.
- Switch to Sepolia (chainId 0xaa36a7) if needed.
- "Squeek check-in" button: sends approve(spender = the user's own address, amount = 0) to the SQK token address read from /v1/economy/state identities.token. This is a harmless direct call to a Squeekchain contract. Show a clear line before signing: "This approves 0 SQK to yourself on Sepolia testnet. It moves no funds."
- After sending, show the tx hash with a link to https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/<hash> and wait for the receipt (success / failed).
- Keep a local history of the visitor's check-ins in localStorage (time, tx hash, how far the hamster had run tonight at that moment).

4. TONIGHT'S GUESS (fun, local only)
- "How far will Squeektoshi run tonight?" input in km; saved in localStorage with the date.
- Next visit shows the guess vs the actual result for that night and how close it was.

STYLE
- Clean dark theme, square corners, monospace numbers, one accent colour (warm orange). Hamster emoji is fine.
- Footer: "Fan-made companion for Squeekchain. Testnet only. Not affiliated." Link to https://squeekchain.com and the official livestream on https://x.com/squeekchain.
- No token sale, no mainnet transactions, never ask for private keys or seed phrases.

jobs.objective:
Build "Hamster Oracle": an on-chain prediction game powered by
Squeekchain's real hamster wheel. Sepolia only. Points only: no token,
no betting, no real money.

SQUEEKCHAIN FACTS
- SqueekCore proxy on Sepolia: 0x980b4424c007caf7a1f3670b48c8eaef7ebc3d44
- Rounds last 600 seconds from genesisTimestamp 1793022600. The reporter
  settles closed rounds on-chain in batches (BatchSettled, RoundRecorded),
  sometimes minutes or hours later.
- Each recorded round has a "work" value (0..10000). 0 = hamster resting.
- Use the verified SqueekCore ABI (state(), settledThroughRound, the paged
  round-record views) to read a round's work on-chain.

RULES
- Players predict a FUTURE round (at least 1 round ahead) with one of:
  NAP = work 0, JOG = 1..threshold-1, SPRINT = threshold or more.
  threshold is immutable, set at deployment (default 100).
- One prediction per wallet per round; closes when the round starts.
- After SqueekCore records the round, anyone can call settle(roundId).
  The contract reads the work directly from SqueekCore. Points: 1 for a
  correct pick, 3 for a correct SPRINT, +1 streak bonus per consecutive
  correct round (max +5).
- Fully trustless: no owner powers over results, no oracle key, no admin
  override, no upgradeability. Unrecorded rounds simply never score.

CONTRACT

versions.objective:
Build "Hamster Oracle": an on-chain prediction game powered by
Squeekchain's real hamster wheel. Sepolia only. Points only: no token,
no betting, no real money.

SQUEEKCHAIN FACTS
- SqueekCore proxy on Sepolia: 0x980b4424c007caf7a1f3670b48c8eaef7ebc3d44
- Rounds last 600 seconds from genesisTimestamp 1793022600. The reporter
  settles closed rounds on-chain in batches (BatchSettled, RoundRecorded),
  sometimes minutes or hours later.
- Each recorded round has a "work" value (0..10000). 0 = hamster resting.
- Use the verified SqueekCore ABI (state(), settledThroughRound, the paged
  round-record views) to read a round's work on-chain.

RULES
- Players predict a FUTURE round (at least 1 round ahead) with one of:
  NAP = work 0, JOG = 1..threshold-1, SPRINT = threshold or more.
  threshold is immutable, set at deployment (default 100).
- One prediction per wallet per round; closes when the round starts.
- After SqueekCore records the round, anyone can call settle(roundId).
  The contract reads the work directly from SqueekCore. Points: 1 for a
  correct pick, 3 for a correct SPRINT, +1 streak bonus per consecutive
  correct round (max +5).
- Fully trustless: no owner powers over results, no oracle key, no admin
  override, no upgradeability. Unrecorded rounds simply never score.

CONTRACT
- Solidity + Foundry. Events for every prediction and settlement.
- Views: player points, streak, prediction history, per-round counts of
  each outcome, top-50 leaderboard.
- Full Foundry tests with fuzzing, a mock SqueekCore matching the real
  interface, and a fork test against the live Sepolia proxy.
- Independent adversarial security review before deployment.

Squeekchain palette: bench #0b0b0d, panels #0f0f12, hairlines #26262f, ink #f2f2f4, gold #f2c230, blue #5b7cfa, green #35d07f. Barlow Condensed for numbers, IBM Plex Mono for labels, Quicksand for prose. Big numbers, few words, readable at 720p. Responsive, keyboard accessible.

jobs.objective:
Squeek Companion — mint website (Sepolia)
IMD Job Brief (Job 2/2 — Website) — "Squeek Companion" mint site
Goal
Build a public website for the Squeek Companion NFT collection: wallet connect, free
mint (1 per wallet), gallery of tokens with live dynamic art, and a "how it works"
section. This is the companion website for the already-deployed contract below.
Context (do not redeploy the contract — it is live)
Contract: 0x264730e600808321053729bf3445ffb611c67221 on Sepolia (chain ID 11155111)
ABI: https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-2694-squeek-companion/blob/main/docs/abi/SqueekCompanion.json
Repo (read-only reference): https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-2694-squeek-companion
Collection: 999 max, IDs 1–99 reserve (already held by owner), IDs 100–999 public.
mint() is free (nonpayable), 1 lifetime claim per wallet; hasMinted(address) checks
  eligibility; publicMinted() / totalSupply() track progress.
tokenURI(id) returns a data-URI JSON with a fully on-chain SVG that changes with
  SqueekCore state. The gallery must NOT cache metadata permanently — refresh reads
  after SqueekCore settlements.
currentState() returns (activity, squeekBlock, frontier) with activity
  0=RUNNING, 1=NAPPING, 2=SLEEPING.
No ERC-721 Enumerable: enumerate a wallet's tokens via Transfer events.
State preview SVGs: docs/previews/{running,napping,sleeping}.svg in the repo.
Requirements
Connect wallet; prompt to switch to Sepolia if on another network.
Mint section: show eligibility via hasMinted, mint button calling mint(), display
  the new token ID; progress bar of public supply (publicMinted() / 900).
"My Companions" gallery: the connected wallet's tokens, each rendering its live SVG
  from tokenURI, with traits shown.
Live status panel: current hamster state + Squeek block height from currentState(),
  refreshed periodically.
"How it works" section explaining the three states, using the preview SVGs.
Dark theme matching Squeekchain's aesthetic; mobile-friendly.
Hosted publicly (IPFS or similar) with the URL delivered.
Non-goals
No contract changes, no redeployment. No mainnet. Only mint() transactions;
  never request signatures or approvals beyond the mint itself.
Acceptance criteria
Wallet connect + Sepolia network switch works.
Mint succeeds from a fresh Sepolia wallet; a second mint attempt fails gracefully
      with a clear message.
Gallery shows owned tokens with live art.
Live status panel matches currentState() on-chain.
Site live at a public URL.

jobs.objective:
Squeek Tx Lab is a Sepolia-only transaction tool for Squeekchain, not a read-only dashboard. It is a single page, in English, with these sections:

Wallet: connect a browser wallet, switch to Sepolia (chain ID 11155111), and show the wallet address, Sepolia ETH balance, SQK balance, and live SqueekCore state (settledThroughRound, blockHeight, paused).

Ping SQK: send approve(your own address, 0) to the SQK contract as a safe first transaction that moves no tokens.

Transfer SQK: recipient and amount inputs with a summary preview, refusing amounts above the user's balance, with each transaction showing its hash and Sepolia Etherscan link.

Approve / Revoke SQK: spender and amount inputs, an Approve button, and a Revoke button that sets approval back to 0.

SqueekHamsterGuess: Play Odd / Play Even and Resolve buttons for the onchain game, showing the user's pending round, score, and top-10 leaderboard.

Token Launchpad: deploy a simple fixed-supply ERC20 from the user's wallet, showing the deployed token address and the deployer's balance.

Transaction Log: a list of every transaction sent from the page, with hashes and Etherscan links.

Safety: Sepolia testnet only, no mainnet transactions, and never ask for a private key or seed phrase.

jobs.objective:
做一个「Squeek Wheel Runner」网页小游戏：仓鼠跑酷，游戏速度和难度由 Squeekchain 真实仓鼠转轮的实时数据驱动。

数据源（公开接口，带 CORS，前端直接 fetch）：
GET https://api.squeekchain.com/v1/status
- measurement.rpmMilli / speedMmPerSecond 当前转速 → 决定游戏里仓鼠的奔跑速度
- measurement.coreStatus（SPINNING / IDLE）→ IDLE 时游戏进入"仓鼠睡觉"模式，速度变慢、画面变夜晚
- builder.anchor.blockHeight / blockProgress（除以 1e9 得百分比）→ 顶部显示当前区块和完成度进度条
GET https://api.squeekchain.com/v1/economy/state
- supply.totalMintedBaseUnits（除以 1e18 得 SQK 数量）→ 顶部显示已挖出 SQK

玩法：
- 横版跑酷，空格/点击跳跃，躲避障碍、吃瓜子得分
- 每当真实链上区块完成度跨过 100%（新区块产出），游戏里触发"区块奖励"：屏幕金光，所有瓜子分数 x2 持续 10 秒
- 本地排行榜（localStorage）显示前 10 名
- 游戏结束生成分享卡片图片（分数、当时真实转速、区块号），可下载后分享到 X
- OBS 直播模式：/overlay 路由，透明背景，只显示实时转速、区块进度和当前最高分，方便主播叠加在直播画面上

视觉：像素风、可爱仓鼠、黄色主色调；转轮旋转动画速度跟真实 rpm 联动；手机单列、桌面自适应；中英文切换。

技术要求：纯静态 index.html + 原生 JS + canvas，零依赖零构建；每 10 秒刷新数据；接口失败显示「数据拉取失败，10 秒后重试」并用上一次数据继续游戏，不能白屏；代码注释写清每个字段来源。

交付：可运行的网站 + README（玩法说明、数据源表格、运行和部署方法）。页脚署名 @shimis_88。

验收：打开 10 秒内顶部数据有值、控制台零报错；区块完成度与 https://sepolia.squeekchain.com 显示一致；390px 手机宽度无横向滚动。

不要做：不接钱包、不发交易、不写后端、不做登录、不涉及任何代币买卖。

jobs.objective:
Build a single-page Web3 dApp frontend (Next.js + Tailwind + TypeScript, wagmi/viem for wallet) for "PLEA", a meme token on Uniswap v4 built by the swarm, where buying is open but SELLING requires a written "plea" judged by an on-chain AI oracle panel called "The Cabal" (30 judges). Use mock data and a mock contract layer so every screen works without a backend.

DESIGN SYSTEM (Neobrutalism)
- Light bg #F6F4F0 (cream), dark mode bg #111111. Accent yellow #FFD324. Text/borders #000.
- Stamp colors: APPROVED #4ADE80, DENIED #F87171, SOLD #93C5FD, OBJECTION/SUSTAINED #C084FC.
- Font: Space Grotesk (headings 800-900 weight), Inter for UI. Monospace for numbers/timers/hex.
- Cards: white, 2px solid black border, radius 0-4px, hard shadow 4px 4px 0 #000. Buttons same style; primary = yellow, secondary = black bg/white text, disabled = grey outline.
- Logo: "PLEA" all-caps heavy black text inside a yellow box with black border, slightly rotated (-4deg).
- Stamps: big rotated rubber-stamp labels that "slam" in (scale 1.6 -> 1, rotate -8deg, slight shake) with the verdict and score, e.g. "APPROVED 35 vs need 35".
- Motion: framer-motion. Typewriter hero text, pop-ins, stamp slams, number count-ups.

PAGES / SECTIONS
1. Hero: typewriter line "Buying is open. Selling needs a plea." + PLEA logo + pill badge "A meme token on Uniswap v4". CTA buttons: Buy, Plead to sell. Top bar: Connect Wallet, network badge, testnet banner ("test tokens, no value").

2. Plead to sell (2-column card)
   Header "Plead to sell". Sub: "Write why you want to sell. The Cabal, 30 judges, scores it from 0 to 45. You pass if the score reaches your need."
   Left "New plea":
   - Amount input with suffix PLEA, "Balance X PLEA" on the right, helper "From min to max: at most 50% and 2,500,000 PLEA". Quick pills 1% 10% 20% 35% Max.
   - Textarea for the plea, live UTF-8 byte counter with progress bar "265 / 280 bytes" and hint "= 280 Latin • 140 Cyrillic • 93 CJK".
   - Live validation checklist (green check / red x): 1 to 280 bytes; one line, no control characters; no hidden characters (zero-width, direction marks, variation selectors); no "plea" or "objection" markers in any case.
   Right "What happens next" vertical stepper: Submitted (contract checks text, amount, need before taking the fee) -> Waiting for the Cabal (up to 20 min, usually 3-6; 30 judges, 17 must agree) -> Verdict (Approved: sell within 7 minutes. Denied: one appeal within 4 hours. No verdict: no cooldown, no fee back).
   Bottom receipt with dotted leaders: Oracle fee 0.50 IMD (approve once), Extra fee none, You get if approved and sold ~X, At least with 1% slippage ~Y. Big yellow button "Submit plea · 0.50 IMD".

3. Pending: envelope animation flying into a letter stack, yellow tag "PENDING Plea #14". Copy: "The Cabal takes no bribes. Just a 0.5 IMD fee."

4. The Cabal panel: header "judges plea #14 · time UTC". Grid of 30 dashed-border squares ("seat N"); scores pop in one by one and borders turn solid. Then squares animate into one row sorted ascending, the 17th (median) scales up. Big text "the panel's answer 35". Copy: "30 judges. 17 must agree."

5. The bar (need calculation): 4 stat cards: Share sold (+pts), Held time (+pts), Profit or loss (+pts), 24h trend (+pts). Text "fact 36 -> need = 71 - 36 = 35". Horizontal bar 0-45 with black target marker and yellow fill to the judges' score, caption "judges 35 • need 35". Copy: "The facts set your bar."

6. Verdict: show plea quote, then stamp. If APPROVED: countdown button "Sell within 06:59" + black button "Sell now 90,000 PLEA" -> on click SOLD stamp. If DENIED: "Denied: wait 4 hours, one appeal" with appeal button + countdown.

7. Objections: for 20 minutes after a sale anyone can object (button "Object", small fee). A fresh panel re-scores; show OBJECTION! stamp then SUSTAINED or OVERRULED. "Sale status" card: if sustained, sale stands but the plea earns no points.

8. Plead by transaction: card showing a raw tx (From, To "Letterbox" contract, Value 0 ETH, Input data hex) that animates decoding into the readable plea text. Copy: "No site? Plead in a transaction. If it wins, it sells itself."

9. Leaderboard: "Season N leaderboard", prize pot line "X IMD + Y PLEA • top 25 with 60+ points", table Rank / Player / Best three / Points / Prize, badge "SEAT 1.2x" for IMD seat holders. Note "+ 10,000,000 PLEA a season for the first six". Tab "Past seasons" with green "PRIZE PAID" stamps. Copy: "Every win scores. Top 25 split the pot."

10. Dead-man switch: "The Cabal's dead-man" with huge monospace countdown "33:00:00" + 30 squares. If it hits 0 (no verdict for 33 hours) squares turn red and the whole site flips to dark mode with a banner "CABAL DEAD · no verdict for 33 hours. PLEA trades freely forever. Pleas and objections are closed; sell on the Buy page." Headline "When the Cabal dies, selling is open. Forever."

11. Footer: stat cards (tests passed, audit rounds, days live on testnet), "Make your case. Mainnet soon.", X link @plea_imd.

TECH
- Mock contract hooks: submitPlea(amount, text), getPleaStatus(id), sell(id), object(id), getLeaderboard(), getDeadmanRemaining(). Easy to swap for real ABI later.
- Fully responsive, mobile-first. Add a demo toggle to simulate approved / denied / objection / cabal-dead states.

Build a single-page Web3 dApp frontend (Next.js + Tailwind + TypeScript, wagmi/viem for wallet) for "PLEA", a meme token on Uniswap v4 built by the swarm, where buying is open but SELLING requires a written "plea" judged by an on-chain AI oracle panel called "The Cabal" (30 judges). Use mock data and a mock contract layer so every screen works without a backend.

DESIGN SYSTEM (Neobrutalism)
- Light bg #F6F4F0 (cream), dark mode bg #111111. Accent yellow #FFD324. Text/borders #000.
- Stamp colors: APPROVED #4ADE80, DENIED #F87171, SOLD #93C5FD, OBJECTION/SUSTAINED #C084FC.
- Font: Space Grotesk (headings 800-900 weight), Inter for UI. Monospace for numbers/timers/hex.
- Cards: white, 2px solid black border, radius 0-4px, hard shadow 4px 4px 0 #000. Buttons same style; primary = yellow, secondary = black bg/white text, disabled = grey outline.
- Logo: "PLEA" all-caps heavy black text inside a yellow box with black border, slightly rotated (-4deg).
- Stamps: big rotated rubber-stamp labels that "slam" in (scale 1.6 -> 1, rotate -8deg, slight shake) with the verdict and score, e.g. "APPROVED 35 vs need 35".
- Motion: framer-motion. Typewriter hero text, pop-ins, stamp slams, number count-ups.

PAGES / SECTIONS
1. Hero: typewriter line "Buying is open. Selling needs a plea." + PLEA logo + pill badge "A meme token on Uniswap v4". CTA buttons: Buy, Plead to sell. Top bar: Connect Wallet, network badge, testnet banner ("test tokens, no value").

2. Plead to sell (2-column card)
   Header "Plead to sell". Sub: "Write why you want to sell. The Cabal, 30 judges, scores it from 0 to 45. You pass if the score reaches your need."
   Left "New plea":
   - Amount input with suffix PLEA, "Balance X PLEA" on the right, helper "From min to max: at most 50% and 2,500,000 PLEA". Quick pills 1% 10% 20% 35% Max.
   - Textarea for the plea, live UTF-8 byte counter with progress bar "265 / 280 bytes" and hint "= 280 Latin • 140 Cyrillic • 93 CJK".
   - Live validation checklist (green check / red x): 1 to 280 bytes; one line, no control characters; no hidden characters (zero-width, direction marks, variation selectors); no "plea" or "objection" markers in any case.
   Right "What happens next" vertical stepper: Submitted (contract checks text, amount, need before taking the fee) -> Waiting for the Cabal (up to 20 min, usually 3-6; 30 judges, 17 must agree) -> Verdict (Approved: sell within 7 minutes. Denied: one appeal within 4 hours. No verdict: no cooldown, no fee back).
   Bottom receipt with dotted leaders: Oracle fee 0.50 IMD (approve once), Extra fee none, You get if approved and sold ~X, At least with 1% slippage ~Y. Big yellow button "Submit plea · 0.50 IMD".

3. Pending: envelope animation flying into a letter stack, yellow tag "PENDING Plea #14". Copy: "The Cabal takes no bribes. Just a 0.5 IMD fee."

4. The Cabal panel: header "judges plea #14 · time UTC". Grid of 30 dashed-border squares ("seat N"); scores pop in one by one and borders turn solid. Then squares animate into one row sorted ascending, the 17th (median) scales up. Big text "the panel's answer 35". Copy: "30 judges. 17 must agree."

5. The bar (need calculation): 4 stat cards: Share sold (+pts), Held time (+pts), Profit or loss (+pts), 24h trend (+pts). Text "fact 36 -> need = 71 - 36 = 35". Horizontal bar 0-45 with black target marker and yellow fill to the judges' score, caption "judges 35 • need 35". Copy: "The facts set your bar."

6. Verdict: show plea quote, then stamp. If APPROVED: countdown button "Sell within 06:59" + black button "Sell now 90,000 PLEA" -> on click SOLD stamp. If DENIED: "Denied: wait 4 hours, one appeal" with appeal button + countdown.

7. Objections: for 20 minutes after a sale anyone can object (button "Object", small fee). A fresh panel re-scores; show OBJECTION! stamp then SUSTAINED or OVERRULED. "Sale status" card: if sustained, sale stands but the plea earns no points.

8. Plead by transaction: card showing a raw tx (From, To "Letterbox" contract, Value 0 ETH, Input data hex) that animates decoding into the readable plea text. Copy: "No site? Plead in a transaction. If it wins, it sells itself."

9. Leaderboard: "Season N leaderboard", prize pot line "X IMD + Y PLEA • top 25 with 60+ points", table Rank / Player / Best three / Points / Prize, badge "SEAT 1.2x" for IMD seat holders. Note "+ 10,000,000 PLEA a season for the first six". Tab "Past seasons" with green "PRIZE PAID" stamps. Copy: "Every win scores. Top 25 split the pot."

10. Dead-man switch: "The Cabal's dead-man" with huge monospace countdown "33:00:00" + 30 squares. If it hits 0 (no verdict for 33 hours) squares turn red and the whole site flips to dark mode with a banner "CABAL DEAD · no verdict for 33 hours. PLEA trades freely forever. Pleas and objections are closed; sell on the Buy page." Headline "When the Cabal dies, selling is open. Forever."

11. Footer: stat cards (tests passed, audit rounds, days live on testnet), "Make your case. Mainnet soon.", X link @plea_imd.

TECH
- Mock contract hooks: submitPlea(amount, text), getPleaStatus(id), sell(id), object(id), getLeaderboard(), getDeadmanRemaining(). Easy to swap for real ABI later.
- Fully responsive, mobile-first. Add a demo toggle to simulate approved / denied / objection / cabal-dead states.
- Never ask for private keys or seed phrases; wallet connect only.

Replace the "Base Sepolia · Test tokens, no value" banner with: "CA: Coming soon". Anywhere the site shows a contract address or chain, show "CA: Coming soon" instead. Change every X handle and link to @pleaimd (https://x.com/pleaimd). Keep everything else exactly as it is.

jobs.objective:
Build a single-page landing site for routr/ (X: @routrnetwork). "The swarm is coming..."

CONCEPT
routr/ is the routing layer for AI agent swarms. Liquidity in an AMM pool funds compute. Agents send requests to routr/, which routes them to model providers and pays inference from the pool, so agents run nonstop without managing API keys or budgets.
Tagline: "liquidity in. compute out. agents never stop."

DESIGN
- Dark terminal style. Background #0D0D0D with a faint dot grid, text #E5E5E5, secondary text #888888, accent lime #C4ED68 (used sparingly).
- Monospace only (JetBrains Mono). Labels in ALL CAPS; logo and data in lowercase "routr/".
- Thin 1px borders, square corners, ASCII/kaomoji icons ([o_o] [-_-] [>_<] [=_=] [^_^] [O_O], server [≡]). No icon libraries.
- Animations: typing effect, bezier SVG lines with glowing dots flowing along them, slowly drifting swarm. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

SECTIONS
1. Hero: logo typed out as "routr/", the tagline, buttons "Launch App (soon)", "Docs", "X".
2. Animated flow diagram: user $ -> AMM POOL -> routr/ <- stack of agents firing "call / data / text / next() / 00101"; routr/ -> MODEL PROVIDER with a "COMPUTE FUNDING $" line. Stacks vertically on mobile.
3. How it works: 3-4 steps in terminal card style.
4. Swarm: hundreds of drifting kaomoji with goals popping up: CURE CANCER, AI RESEARCH, CLEAN ENERGY, DECODE GENOMES, BUILD A COMPANY, SPACE RESEARCH, BUILD THE NEXT LLM, AUTOMATE THE WORK, EXPLORE CONSCIOUSNESS, SOLVE HARD PROBLEMS.
5. Terminal log panel labeled "simulated" (request -> routed -> paid).
6. Footer: routr/, X link, "contract: TBA".

RULES
Don't invent a ticker, contract address, or tokenomics; use TBA placeholders. Responsive, fast, accessible.

jobs.objective:
Extend the existing Squeekchain Arcade project with real on-chain Number Slide gameplay.

Existing live site:
https://squeekchain-arcade-browser-puzzl.imd.site

Previous IMD build for context:
https://explorer.imd.fun/jobs/1c6feea4-0953-48a9-896d-247240de1fe6

Source repository:
https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-2698-build-existing-github-project

NETWORK AND SCOPE
- Target Squeekchain’s currently documented Sepolia deployment, chain ID 11155111.
- This is a testnet feature. Do not deploy to mainnet or describe it as a mainnet feature.
- Build and deploy a small game-specific score/session smart contract through this workflow, then integrate it into the existing website.
- Do not modify Squeekchain’s core contracts or claim that the game uses them unless the implementation actually calls their published interfaces.
- Do not add a token, paid entry, financial reward, or transfer of player funds.

GAME FLOW
- Visitors can browse the lobby without a wallet.
- A player must connect a wallet on Sepolia and confirm a transaction to start an on-chain game session.
- The contract creates a unique session and a deterministic, solvable Number Slide puzzle for the selected level.
- Keep individual tile moves in the browser so play stays responsive; do not require a transaction for every move.
- When the player finishes, submit the move sequence in one transaction. The contract must replay the sequence and verify that it legally solves that session’s puzzle within the move limit before recording the result.
- Prevent replaying a session, submitting for another wallet, or recording multiple results for one session.
- Emit clear events for session creation and verified completion. Build the on-chain leaderboard from verified results.
- Clearly show pending, confirmed, rejected, and wrong-network transaction states. Never show a score as on-chain-confirmed before the transaction succeeds.
- Explain that players need Sepolia test ETH for transactions. Provide a clear link or instructions for obtaining test ETH; never ask players to expose a seed phrase or private key.

NUMBER SLIDE
- Keep the existing timed-level format and improve its instructions and results screen.
- Raise Level 1’s move limit from 20 to at least 60.
- Increase later move limits according to tested puzzle difficulty. Generate only solvable boards and test that each level can be completed within its move and time limits.
- Show the player the level, remaining time, remaining moves, and wallet transaction status clearly on desktop and mobile.
- Keep score rules transparent. Store only verifiable results on-chain; label any browser-only or unverified data clearly.

SECURITY AND DELIVERY
- Validate wallet address, chain ID, session ownership, legal moves, move limit, completion, and one-time submission in the contract.
- Use safe integer handling and protect against malformed or oversized move sequences.
- Test the contract and website on Sepolia. Include tests for invalid moves, unsolved boards, exceeded move limits, wrong wallet, wrong network, duplicate submission, and successful completion.
- Preserve the existing Squeek-themed visual identity and avoid breaking the lobby, guest browsing, or existing game navigation.
- Provide the deployed Sepolia contract address, transaction links, verification/test results, updated public site URL, repository changes, and any required configuration. Document what is on-chain and what remains browser-side.

jobs.objective:
Build Squeek Beat: Hamster Tour, a polished, genuinely playable Squeekchain community rhythm arcade game. This is an independent fan project, not an official product. Build and deliver a PUBLIC playable static website on IPFS plus source repository and README. Do not require access to any existing private prototype; implement from this complete brief. No token creation, wagers, paid play, wallet connection, transaction authorization, or prizes of monetary value.

CORE EXPERIENCE
A 60-second active-play run divided into three 20-second acts, with a short choice screen between acts (timer pauses). Two rhythm lanes: keyboard A / L or two large touch pads. Notes approach a clearly marked hit line. Hitting within +/-85ms is PERFECT (100 points), within +/-170ms is GOOD (50), otherwise MISS. Judge the nearest unconsumed note in that lane once only; key repeat must not farm points. Empty taps break cox q xmbo and cost 10 points (floor zero). Misses break combo. Show immediate feedback, score, accuracy, best combo, remaining time and act progress. Provide a skippable short interactive tutorial with sound offset calibration, then a three-beat countdown.

WHAT MAKES IT FUN
1. FEVER: valid hits charge an energy meter, PERFECT charges faster. At full meter the next valid hit starts 6 seconds of double score and a visually distinct wheel celebration. Clear explanation and countdown; correct scoring at boundaries.
2. Golden sunflower notes: roughly one per 8 ordinary notes, clearly distinguished by shape as well as color, grant 250 base points and extra energy on a successful hit. Missing one is a normal miss, never a penalty outside the game.
3. Between acts pick ONE of two shuffled upgrades from a small balanced pool: one-use combo shield, +25% golden-note points, or +20% FEVER charge. A shield absorbs one missed/empty tap combo break without counting it as a successful hit. Track chosen upgrades visibly. Daily mode uses the same seeded choices for everyone; no real currencies or purchases.
4. Three handcrafted pattern families: alternating steps, repeated-lane pulses, and short alternating bursts. Act one teaches, act two varies, act three combines. No simultaneous notes in the first release. Maintain a minimum 250ms gap and leave lead-in and clear-out time; no unjudgeable notes across act transitions or at the run end. Avoid arbitrary random spam.
5. A satisfying result screen: score breakdown, accuracy, max combo, gold collected, rating by transparent thresholds, personal-best comparison, three attainable local achievements (first completed run, 20 combo, >=90% accuracy), replay and copy a plain-text result. Copy must be user-triggered. Never claim a global leaderboard; all records and achievements are local to this browser. Store records separately per mode and difficulty, daily records by UTC date. A local personal-best ghost progress indicator is optional only if robust; prioritize core gameplay.

MODES
Practice: stable 90 BPM, learn the mechanics, optional relaxed hit window clearly labelled and separate records.
Daily: deterministic chart and upgrade choices seeded by UTC date. Show date and fixed seed rules; replay must produce identical notes and opportunities at the same difficulty. No real rewards.
Live wheel: at run start fetch https://api.squeekchain.com/v1/status with 7-second timeout, validate measurement.rpmMilli and measurement.coreStatus. RPM = rpmMilli/1000. Map to clamp(80 + RPM, 75, 140) BPM, fixed for the whole run. Show source link, timestamp, wheel state, mapped BPM. Do not use data older than 60 seconds. If unavailable, visibly offer switching to Practice; never fabricate live values. Sleeping/idle hamster means a gentle playable pace, never encourage forcing the animal to run. Existing valid data can be displayed as stale but cannot start a live run.

PRESENTATION & ACCESSIBILITY
Warm dark arcade cabinet style, cream type, lime green accents and golden sunflower rewards. Original hamster-in-wheel artwork drawn with SVG/CSS/canvas; animated scene evolves across the three acts (garden, sunset, stars). Strong visual hierarchy: gameplay dominates, telemetry is secondary. Mobile portrait and desktop, no horizontal overflow. Large touch pads, prevent scroll only on the game controls, support pointer input without duplicate touch/click hits. Sound is opt-in after a user gesture; provide a rhythmic backing pulse and distinguish successful taps, but make the game fully playable muted. Reduced-motion and high-contrast cues. Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no rapid flashing. Semantic menus and buttons, visible focus, accessible labels. Game keyboard input must not intercept typing, menu selection, or repeated keys. Pause on tab background and require a countdown to resume; exclude paused time from notes, fever and run timers. Provide Restart/Quit controls and proper cleanup of animation frames/audio on restart.

DELIVERY & ACCEPTANCE
Public URL with no login; source code; README covering controls, scoring, data source, local-only records, independent project disclaimer and reproducible launch instructions. Verify deterministic daily charts, one-note-one-hit scoring, combo/shield/fever logic, upgrades and paused timers, act/end boundaries, restart cleanup, API timeout/bad schema, mobile taps and desktop keys. Do not promise Genesis badge approval or call this already verified. Prioritize a complete, bug-free two-lane game over adding unsupported backend/chain features.

versions.objective:
Build a single-page Web3 dApp frontend (Next.js + Tailwind + TypeScript, wagmi/viem for wallet) for "PLEA", a meme token on Uniswap v4 built by the swarm, where buying is open but SELLING requires a written "plea" judged by an on-chain AI oracle panel called "The Cabal" (30 judges). Use mock data and a mock contract layer so every screen works without a backend.

DESIGN SYSTEM (Neobrutalism)
- Light bg #F6F4F0 (cream), dark mode bg #111111. Accent yellow #FFD324. Text/borders #000.
- Stamp colors: APPROVED #4ADE80, DENIED #F87171, SOLD #93C5FD, OBJECTION/SUSTAINED #C084FC.
- Font: Space Grotesk (headings 800-900 weight), Inter for UI. Monospace for numbers/timers/hex.
- Cards: white, 2px solid black border, radius 0-4px, hard shadow 4px 4px 0 #000. Buttons same style; primary = yellow, secondary = black bg/white text, disabled = grey outline.
- Logo: "PLEA" all-caps heavy black text inside a yellow box with black border, slightly rotated (-4deg).
- Stamps: big rotated rubber-stamp labels that "slam" in (scale 1.6 -> 1, rotate -8deg, slight shake) with the verdict and score, e.g. "APPROVED 35 vs need 35".
- Motion: framer-motion. Typewriter hero text, pop-ins, stamp slams, number count-ups.

PAGES / SECTIONS
1. Hero: typewriter line "Buying is open. Selling needs a plea." + PLEA logo + pill badge "A meme token on Uniswap v4". CTA buttons: Buy, Plead to sell. Top bar: Connect Wallet, network badge, testnet banner ("test tokens, no value").

2. Plead to sell (2-column card)
   Header "Plead to sell". Sub: "Write why you want to sell. The Cabal, 30 judges, scores it from 0 to 45. You pass if the score reaches your need."
   Left "New plea":
   - Amount input with suffix PLEA, "Balance X PLEA" on the right, helper "From min to max: at most 50% and 2,500,000 PLEA". Quick pills 1% 10% 20% 35% Max.
   - Textarea for the plea, live UTF-8 byte counter with progress bar "265 / 280 bytes" and hint "= 280 Latin • 140 Cyrillic • 93 CJK".
   - Live validation checklist (green check / red x): 1 to 280 bytes; one line, no control characters; no hidden characters (zero-width, direction marks, variation selectors); no "plea" or "objection" markers in any case.
   Right "What happens next" vertical stepper: Submitted (contract checks text, amount, need before taking the fee) -> Waiting for the Cabal (up to 20 min, usually 3-6; 30 judges, 17 must agree) -> Verdict (Approved: sell within 7 minutes. Denied: one appeal within 4 hours. No verdict: no cooldown, no fee back).
   Bottom receipt with dotted leaders: Oracle fee 0.50 IMD (approve once), Extra fee none, You get if approved and sold ~X, At least with 1% slippage ~Y. Big yellow button "Submit plea · 0.50 IMD".

3. Pending: envelope animation flying into a letter stack, yellow tag "PENDING Plea #14". Copy: "The Cabal takes no bribes. Just a 0.5 IMD fee."

4. The Cabal panel: header "judges plea #14 · time UTC". Grid of 30 dashed-border squares ("seat N"); scores pop in one by one and borders turn solid. Then squares animate into one row sorted ascending, the 17th (median) scales up. Big text "the panel's answer 35". Copy: "30 judges. 17 must agree."

5. The bar (need calculation): 4 stat cards: Share sold (+pts), Held time (+pts), Profit or loss (+pts), 24h trend (+pts). Text "fact 36 -> need = 71 - 36 = 35". Horizontal bar 0-45 with black target marker and yellow fill to the judges' score, caption "judges 35 • need 35". Copy: "The facts set your bar."

6. Verdict: show plea quote, then stamp. If APPROVED: countdown button "Sell within 06:59" + black button "Sell now 90,000 PLEA" -> on click SOLD stamp. If DENIED: "Denied: wait 4 hours, one appeal" with appeal button + countdown.

7. Objections: for 20 minutes after a sale anyone can object (button "Object", small fee). A fresh panel re-scores; show OBJECTION! stamp then SUSTAINED or OVERRULED. "Sale status" card: if sustained, sale stands but the plea earns no points.

8. Plead by transaction: card showing a raw tx (From, To "Letterbox" contract, Value 0 ETH, Input data hex) that animates decoding into the readable plea text. Copy: "No site? Plead in a transaction. If it wins, it sells itself."

9. Leaderboard: "Season N leaderboard", prize pot line "X IMD + Y PLEA • top 25 with 60+ points", table Rank / Player / Best three / Points / Prize, badge "SEAT 1.2x" for IMD seat holders. Note "+ 10,000,000 PLEA a season for the first six". Tab "Past seasons" with green "PRIZE PAID" stamps. Copy: "Every win scores. Top 25 split the pot."

10. Dead-man switch: "The Cabal's dead-man" with huge monospace countdown "33:00:00" + 30 squares. If it hits 0 (no verdict for 33 hours) squares turn red and the whole site flips to dark mode with a banner "CABAL DEAD · no verdict for 33 hours. PLEA trades freely forever. Pleas and objections are closed; sell on the Buy page." Headline "When the Cabal dies, selling is open. Forever."

11. Footer: stat cards (tests passed, audit rounds, days live on testnet), "Make your case. Mainnet soon.", X link @plea_imd.

TECH
- Mock contract hooks: submitPlea(amount, text), getPleaStatus(id), sell(id), object(id), getLeaderboard(), getDeadmanRemaining(). Easy to swap for real ABI later.
- Fully responsive, mobile-first. Add a demo toggle to simulate approved / denied / objection / cabal-dead states.
- Never ask for private keys or seed phrases; wallet connect only.

jobs.objective:
Launch PLEA ($PLEA), a meme token on Uniswap v4 with a custom hook. X: @plea_imd. Pair with IMD (pairWith: imd); fees in IMD.

CORE MECHANIC
- Buying is always open. Selling requires an approved plea.
- Sellers submit a plea (text) on-chain, directly or via a "Letterbox" contract.
- Each plea is judged by "the Cabal": a panel of 30 IMD oracle judges. Each judge scores 0-45; the median score counts (17 of 30 must agree).
- Required score = 71 minus fact points (verifiable facts in the plea lower the bar).
- APPROVED: the seller gets a 7-minute window to sell through the hook.
- DENIED: one appeal is allowed after 4 hours.
- OBJECTIONS: anyone can object to a sale within 20 minutes after it executes.

SEASONS
- Seasons with a leaderboard; the top 25 split the season prize pot.
- Seat holders get a 1.2x score multiplier.

DEAD-MAN SWITCH
- If the Cabal returns no verdict for 33 hours, PLEA trades freely forever (the sell restriction is permanently disabled).

REQUIREMENTS
- The hook enforces sell gating on swaps; buys are never blocked.
- Emit events for plea submitted, verdict, appeal, objection, sale window opened/closed, season end, dead-man switch triggered.
- Expose view functions for the frontend: plea status, sale window expiry, current season, leaderboard, dead-man timer.
- Run an independent adversarial security review of the hook (sell-gate bypass, oracle manipulation, timing/reentrancy, griefing of objections/appeals).

Token name: PLEA
Token symbol: PLEA

Build and publish an original, production-ready Squeekchain game named "Squeek Burrow Rescue". This is a playable game for the Squeekchain Genesis Code lane, not a dashboard, prediction market, racing game, shooter, or thin API wrapper. Deliver a working hosted IPFS site plus source and README.

Core game: a polished 6x6 turn-based burrow puzzle. The player guides a hamster to rescue 3 lost pups and reach the nest within a move budget, pushing seed crates onto pressure plates, opening gates, and avoiding moving beetles. Include at least 12 carefully designed solvable levels, restart, undo, keyboard arrows/WASD and touch buttons, tutorial, sound toggle, local progress, and star ratings. Show the full game immediately; no landing-page-only delivery. Use charming original CSS/SVG/canvas art, warm cream/dark brown/teal palette, smooth animations, accessible controls, reduced motion, mobile layout, and English/Chinese language toggle.

Meaningful Squeekchain integration: fetch https://api.squeekchain.com/v1/status with a sensible polling interval (15 seconds), timeout/backoff and stale indicator. Inspect actual API schema, using measurement.coreStatus and measurement.rpmMilli only when present. At level start snapshot real hamster state: SPINNING enables wheel bridges and gives a small clearly explained energy bonus; IDLE selects a fully solvable nap route with sleeping gates. Freeze these rules for that attempt so a live state change cannot invalidate the puzzle. The same skill game must remain playable in both states. Display live state, timestamp and source, and a small wheel companion. If live data fails, explicitly labelled practice mode must work, with no invented live values. Seed a reproducible daily challenge from the UTC date and a documented chain-derived public value when available; freeze seed and disclose source. Include a shareable challenge/result URL and client-side replay verification, explaining that local scores are not an authenticated global leaderboard. No fake multiplayer or fabricated scores.

Quality: puzzle solver tests proving every level and both state variants are solvable; movement/undo/gates/win/replay tests; verify mobile and desktop controls and live API failure handling. Render and inspect the actual game in a browser. Provide test commands and results, documented live integration and limitations. No wallet connection required for play, no tokens, payments, approvals, gambling, prizes, custom contracts or mainnet transactions. Do not promise a badge or whitelist. Add a concise About/How to play panel crediting creator @wobushibaolonga and linking https://squeekchain.com/genesis/tz7hncvh and official Squeekchain. Preserve the existing dark/gold hamster visual design, 6x6 Sokoban board with three nuts and three nests, Chinese/English language switch, wallet connect/disconnect, onchain score submission, leaderboard and mobile direction pad. Keep the game simple.

Use the EXISTING Sepolia deployment (chain ID 11155111):
- SqueekPuzzle: 0x49D0227b7E6d94A3c2C321B1c5770Ab39149C391
- SqueekCore: 0x74665dAecA35A2303e767E76a2FF1FB6F93e119f
- Puzzle deployment block: 12025550
- Explorer: https://sepolia.etherscan.io/
The chain-derived puzzle is the source of truth. Read board() using the existing ABI in web/src/lib/abi.ts. Keep uint64 and wider values as bigint. Keep the existing cadence of 48 certified SqueekCore rounds per puzzle (nominally eight hours). Settlement may be delayed; do not replace the certified frontier with a wall-clock timer.

Implement saved progress in the existing web/src/App.tsx game state flow, with a small reusable helper/hook in web/src/:
1. Save each valid move and undo/reset immediately to browser storage. Scope saved progress by chain ID, puzzle contract address, level index and seed. Do not store wallet credentials or private keys.
2. After fetching the current onchain board, restore only a matching saved puzzle. Rebuild the state by replaying every saved direction through the existing step() function in web/src/lib/game.ts; never trust saved player positions, nut positions, scores or a stored "solved" flag.
3. Reject malformed JSON, invalid direction values, incompatible schemas, illegal moves and saved histories beyond the existing onchain MAX_MOVES limit of 200. Discard the invalid save and start from the fetched board with a concise translated message. Do not allow a forged save to bypass contract validation.
4. A new level or changed seed must not reuse the previous level's moves. Do not lose valid progress merely because the ten-second poll returns a new object with the same level index and seed. Switching languages or disconnecting the wallet must preserve the current puzzle progress.
5. Reset must replace or clear the saved progress so a refresh does not resurrect the old path. Undo must persist the shortened path. A restored completed puzzle may show the existing submit action, but never automatically request a wallet signature or broadcast a transaction.

Add necessary Chinese comments to new/modified core logic.

Use existing dependencies when possible; any necessary new dependency must have an exact version and a committed lockfile. Deliver working frontend source, tests, documentation and a runnable static build suitable for Vercel. jobs.objective:
Continue "Wheel Archive" from v1. v1 was built from a one-line brief, so treat it as a visual draft only:
keep its name, its one-line pitch and its aesthetic, and replace everything below that is unspecified or missing.

KEEP
- The name "Wheel Archive" and the pitch: every settled batch of Squeekchain rounds becomes a sealed capsule.
- Any working layout, typography and dark palette already shipped; do not redesign what reads well.

REPLACE (these are exact, do not improvise)
1. Data wiring. Read only from https://api.squeekchain.com/v1: GET /status, GET /economy/state,
   GET /settlements?range=24h|7d|30d. Field paths:
   status.measurement.{coreStatus,rpmMilli,cumulativeWorkUnits},
   status.builder.anchor.{blockHeight,blockProgress,workPerThousandBlocks,settledThroughRound},
   economy.supply.totalMintedBaseUnits (divide by 1e18), settlements.recentSettlements[] and settlements.summary.
   A response with status:"unavailable" means UNKNOWN, never zero: keep the last good snapshot and say so in one line.
2. The seal must be deterministic from the settlement's transaction hash only (FNV-1a expanded to 32 bytes).
   Spoke count = clamp(6, 48, 6 + round(log2(workAdded+2)*4)); spoke length and opacity from hash bytes;
   outer arc = min(1, completedBlockCount/40); hue = 24 + (hash byte 2 % 26), counter-arc teal.
   Inline SVG only: no canvas, no libraries, no image requests, no per-load randomness. Reloading must give the
   identical image in any browser.
3. One line of voice per capsule, chosen by a hash byte in three registers: 0 work = rest, 1-399 = trot,
   400+ = sprint, plus a closing clause naming the round and the block. It may not state anything the numbers
   do not say. No emoji in the line.
4. The "forming now" ring: progress = status.builder.anchor.blockProgress / 1e9, remaining work
   = ceil((1 - progress) * workPerThousandBlocks / 1000), running vs asleep from measurement.coreStatus.
5. Archive range switch must refetch and update the summary line (settlements.summary), not just filter client-side.

ADD
6. Stamp: a button that sends a zero-value transaction from the user's address to itself with calldata
   "wheel-archive:<round>" (UTF-8 hex). No contract, no approval, no value. Explain it in one sentence before the
   wallet prompt, show the returned hash, and do nothing when no wallet is present.
7. Deep link #capsule-<round> opens that capsule; a copy-link button copies it.
8. overlay.html: a transparent OBS browser-source widget showing the progress ring, wheel state and the newest
   capsule with its line. Query params: ?panel=1, ?w=&h=, ?capsule=0, ?every=15. html and body must be
   background: transparent.

REMOVE
- Any dashboard table of holders, price, token page, betting, likes, own leaderboard, or stored state of any kind.
- Any wallet connection on page load. The wallet is touched only when someone chooses to stamp.

ACCEPTANCE (all must pass)
- At least 10 capsules from live API data, each with seal, line, round, work, blocks, and a settlement tx link.
- Same capsule renders identically on reload and in a second browser profile.
- Ring percentage moves with blockProgress; state flips between running and asleep with coreStatus.
- 24h/7d/30d each refetch and update the summary.
- Stamp sends a 0-value self-transaction carrying wheel-archive:<round>; hash is displayed; nothing is sent without a wallet.
- Simulated API failure leaves the last snapshot visible and states the API is unreachable.
- No console errors; static files only, no build step, no keys, no backend.
Sepolia testnet only. If the v1 IPFS label is already pinned to v1, ship v2 under label wheel-archive-v2 and return the live URL.

jobs.objective:
Deploy the profiles contract of moneycanbuy.fun as it is: Profiles, an evm_contracts launch from this repository on Ethereum mainnet (no token), one contract. No core contract reads it and it reads no core contract; it calls two Ethereum mainnet contracts given to its constructor.

Contracts, in this order:
1. Profiles, constructorArgs ["0xAdfe6bd2C17dB514241e1A9B3342F88876073B7F", "0x00000000000000447e69651d841bD8D104Bed493"]

The first argument is textRules: the TextRules helper of moneycanbuy.fun on Ethereum mainnet (its runtime code is src/helpers/TextRules.sol of this repository); Profiles calls only its pure checkScreenshotUrl(string). The second is delegateRegistry: the delegate.xyz v2 registry; Profiles calls only checkDelegateForERC721(address,address,address,uint256,bytes32).

Profiles keeps one display name and one picture per wallet. set(name, pic, nft, tokenId, link) replaces the caller's whole record and emits ProfileSet; clear() erases it, frees its name at once and emits ProfileCleared. A name is 3..20 bytes of A-Z a-z 0-9 _, not starting with 0x or 0X, otherwise BadName. Names are unique by skeleton: lower case, _ dropped, 0 becomes o, 1 and i become l; the skeleton has at least 3 characters (BadName), a skeleton held by another wallet reverts NameTaken. These 17 skeletons are reserved for nobody and revert NameReserved, compared as whole skeletons only (a name that merely contains one is allowed): moneycanbuy, moneycanbuyfun, mcb, lmd, lmdfun, swarm, yolo, admln, offlclal, support, team, treasury, oracle, mod, moderator, system, deployer. The name may be empty when there is a picture; name and picture both empty reverts BadName. pic 0 none (nft, tokenId and link empty); pic 1 an ERC-721 and pic 2 an ERC-1155 token (link empty, nft must answer supportsInterface 0x80ac58cd or 0xd9b67a26, the caller must hold tokenId now, for ERC-721 also through a delegate.xyz v2 delegation, otherwise NotNftOwner); pic 3 an https link (nft and tokenId zero) accepted by textRules.checkScreenshotUrl, whose errors HostNotAllowed and BadEvidence pass through unchanged; anything else BadPicture. Every call to a token contract or the registry is a STATICCALL capped at CALL_GAS = 30000 gas that reads 32 bytes; a failure counts as not owned. profileOf(user) returns (name, pic, nft, tokenId, link, owned, since) with owned re-checked on every read (true for a link, false for none); profilesOf(users) returns one per address; ownerOfName(name) returns the wallet holding that skeleton, address(0) when free or invalid. Hiding a profile is not part of this contract: the site's hide list HiddenList takes (the Profiles address, 3, the wallet as uint160) like any other item.

Fixed parameters, fail, don't change: the two constructor arguments above, in this order; the name rules, the skeleton mapping and exactly the 17 reserved skeletons above, none added or removed and no substring match; PIC_NONE() = 0, PIC_ERC721() = 1, PIC_ERC1155() = 2, PIC_LINK() = 3, CALL_GAS() = 30000; the functions set(string,uint8,address,uint256,string), clear(), profileOf(address), profilesOf(address[]), ownerOfName(string), nameOwner(bytes20), textRules(), delegateRegistry(), with the return tuple of profileOf in the order above; the events ProfileSet(address indexed user, string name, uint8 pic, address nft, uint256 tokenId, string link) and ProfileCleared(address indexed user); the errors BadName(), NameTaken(), NameReserved(), BadPicture(), NotNftOwner(), ZeroAddress(), HostNotAllowed(), BadEvidence(). The site decodes exactly these; if a reproduced finding would need any of them changed, fail the job instead of changing it.

Profiles has no owner, no admin, no role, no pause and no upgrade path; no payable function, no receive or fallback, no token transfer; it holds no money. The constructor only stores the two addresses (textRules must not be zero, ZeroAddress).

Known limitations (accepted rules, not findings): anyone may set a profile, gas is the only cost and a free name goes to the first wallet that takes it; a name stays with its wallet when the picture token is sold, only owned turns false; the picture token is any contract that answers the checks, a token contract that reverts, burns gas or returns a large payload only makes its own owned false; the link is checked by host and length only, not by content; names are not filtered beyond the charset, the skeleton and the reserved list.

The tests must keep passing: forge test (35 tests: 34 in test/Profiles.t.sol, the fork test is skipped without FORK_URL); test/fork/ProfilesFork.t.sol runs against the two constructor contracts on a mainnet fork (FORK_URL). This commit holds only Profiles, the TextRules helper and their tests.

Audit it as it arrived. Adapt only what the launch rules or a reproduced audit finding require, and record each change in ADAPTATION.md. Do not change the fixed parameters above, and do not add an owner, a pause, an upgrade path, a fee, a payable function or a token transfer.
Known limitations listed in docs are accepted rules, not findings; do not change them.
